capabilities: Define JSON hyperlink rules mapping text patterns to URL templates
Match text with regular expressions and $0/$N placeholders
Insert links automatically into the reading view of documents
Optionally rewrite matched text with links in the editor via an experimental setting
Order multiple rules and toggle the feature on mobile
extras: The README marks only the editor-editing mode as experimental and warns it directly edits documents and could produce unexpected results; reading-view insertion is the default behavior. Includes a step-by-step walkthrough to try the plugin.
motivation: If a document contains many instances of a word, the plugin links all of them automatically - no manual linking, no omission.
problem: Linking recurring words or phrases across a document by hand is slow and easy to miss; Obsidian has no automatic rule-based link insertion.
summary: Rule-based plugin that automatically inserts hyperlinks into matching text in reading view using user-defined JSON matching rules.
